subject.why: The rope bridge with the required hanging lantern is clearly depicted.

category.why: The environment exceeds a simple bottom strip with large cliffs and foliage filling the right side.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The posts and ropes crowd and cut off at the left and top edges.

colour.why: Vibrant, saturated palette with good contrast against the sky.

detail.why: Excessive environmental scenery and vegetation competing with the main subject.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D style matches the reference rendering.

fix: Reduce the right-side cliff and foliage to a simple bottom strip, and pull the camera back so the bridge posts are not cropped at the edges.
